items.title: 67425_Tiny Grimes oral history interview
items.q: Flip Wilson, Redd Foxx -- the biggest of names

ctx.x: And you can hear it. If they whispered it it would be bad enough, but they be talkin' loud. Conversations and arguments and you tryin' to entertain someone. And there's a guy at the next table that wants to hear it, and he gets made. So you got a confrontation, face to face thing. Its bad at times. Its disgusting. All right.

To give you an example of what I'm saying -- appreciation -- the fans -- now if the Rolling Stones -- not to even mention the Beatles -- or any group with some kind of a hit record come in town at the airport, there's 5 and 10 thousand people there to meet 'em -- supporters. Tell me just once out of your five fingers -- one time that James Brown, Ella Fitzgerald, Sarah Vaughan, Flip Wilson, Redd Foxx -- the biggest of names -- King Cole -- I don't care how big the names are that's come into town to play and…
Are things any different in other countries?
